name: XPRS 1.3.2
body:
## XPRS 1.3.2

### The rooms catch up
- **Local, Regional and Global keep what was said while you were away.** A phone used to show a stranger's room message only while it was live, and lost it on the next open; the catch-up fetched it back from a nearby station and it was dropped again. Room messages heard within their scope are now kept, bounded by the archive quota and age cap. Nothing changes about what the phone *serves*: it announces no archiver role and answers strangers from its own publications only.
- **A busy room no longer hides a quiet one.** Chat 0.7.58 refills one room at a time; before, a Meshtastic channel bridged into Regional could fill the whole refill window and leave Local empty.

### Web chat (phone share server and ESP32 hotspot)
- Older messages of each room show on open: the page asks each room's archive separately (`room=` on `/api/xprs/history`).
- Traffic shows one entry per packet, with a tag per radio it went out or came in on.
- The dead settings link under the chat is gone.

### Stations
- ESP32 firmware published alongside: a station now answers a history ask on the radio the asker can hear, not only the one the first copy of the ask arrived on.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2
